items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: No, I can't remember that man's name, Charlie... not Charlie. Willie somethin'.

ctx.x: No, I can't remember that man's name, Charlie... not Charlie. Willie somethin'. I think his name is Willie Bryant or something like that. An' we used to have plenty of fun, jus' me and him, we were settin' up an' he play the piano for me and play all the popular numbers. And then I learned how to sing the popular songs...pop songs...was on the ...on the radio and on the Victrolas. So I picked up some more education that way by singing.
